Wild will refer you to a Revolution Gunsmith, who will visit the next day and then once a week, selling gun frame chips, gun mod chips and arms supplies. (Unlocks Revolution Gunsmith content.)

Seven vanilla chips (silencer, red dot sight, laser sight, the standard, high-capacity and extended 10mm magazines, Ironcraft 10 frame) consume metal ingots (some with 3D printing filament) instead of scrap metal. Recipes using ingots require the Metal Printing Module. Existing chips follow the setting. Before uninstalling this mod, turn this off and load and save once, or the chips in the save keep the ingot recipes.

Master switch for these features: street clashes and gun buyer reputation, famous guns and gun oil, paint and stickers, the Upper-Level Gunsmith, the underground range and the company frame chips sold by the Revolution Gunsmith. When off, nothing new comes of them. There are no new clashes and no new sources of paint, stickers or gun oil. The upper-level gun buyer asks for no premium paint, and orders pay no famous gun bonus. The Upper-Level Gunsmith and Underground Range upgrade cards are hidden, the gunsmith does not answer the phone (a visit booked before still comes, with vanilla goods only) and the range is closed. Gun buyer visit chances, order rewards and disassembly parts are vanilla again. What you have stays: paint, stickers and gun history still show and count in prices, and bought upgrades and everything at the range stay in the save and are back when it is on again. While it is off, the three Deep groups below do nothing. Takes effect after restarting the game.
Street clashes between the Revolution and Security. When off, no new clash starts. One already under way plays out.

Only gun orders other than repairs count towards reputation. A New or Excellent gun earns reputation if its base Firepower, Style, Reliability, Ergonomics and Accuracy add up to at least those of a new gun of the same model. A Fair or Poor war-damaged gun costs reputation. Every 3 days without such a sale, it moves 1 back toward 0. It runs from -15 to +15 and changes the three gun buyers' visit chance (up to 15% either way) and order rewards (up to 7.5% either way). Together with the range crowd and the famous and war-damaged guns in the showcase, the visit bonus stops at +30%. When off, it neither changes nor counts.

A famous gun that goes 7 days without gun oil loses its famous gun bonus (+15%) over the next 8 days. When off, the famous gun bonus doesn't fade and needs no oil. You can still use oil to clear war damage once a gun is in Good condition or better. Turned back on, the 7 days start over.
Guns from the mercenary seller have a base 50% chance to carry 1 to 24 kills. Luck affects this chance. With 20 or more, it is a famous gun. When off, no kills.
Mercenaries sometimes come to rent a gun. When off, no new rentals start. Guns already out are still returned or paid for.
